title: Jack's art turns to grids, matching a world-grid book

tellings.quote: he was incorporating grids in all of his artwork and in very incredibly intriguing ways.

plain: A man named Jim Weiner says that around 1976 in Boston, the artist Jack Weiner began putting grids into all of his artwork "in very incredibly intriguing ways." He says those grids matched ones in The Anti-Gravity and the World Grid, a book by the author David Hatcher Childress about a network of lines over the Earth. Jim Weiner tells it as something he saw, in an episode on alien abduction, as a sign that Jack's art was shaped by something beyond his own knowledge.
